def solve(case):
    payload = case['payload']
    items = payload['items']
    required = set(payload['required_failure_items'])
    for r in required:
        if r not in items:
            raise ValueError("Required failure item not in items")
    current = list(items)
    g = 2
    attempts = 0
    while True:
        if g >= len(current):
            # singleton granularity: try removing entire list (single chunk)
            # only one chunk possible
            attempts += 1
            chunk = current[:]
            # check if removing entire list leaves required items? No, it leaves none, so always fails
            # but we still check for completeness
            new_current = []
            if all(r in new_current for r in required):
                current = new_current
            # break after this attempt regardless
            break
        found = False
        for i in range(len(current) - g + 1):
            attempts += 1
            chunk = current[i:i+g]
            new_current = current[:i] + current[i+g:]
            if all(r in new_current for r in required):
                current = new_current
                g = g + 1  # slightly coarser
                found = True
                break
        if not found:
            g = g * 2
            # loop will check condition at top
    # compute one-minimal
    one_minimal = True
    for i in range(len(current)):
        temp = current[:i] + current[i+1:]
        if all(r in temp for r in required):
            one_minimal = False
            break
    return {"reduced_items": current, "attempts": attempts, "one_minimal": one_minimal}
